# discord_test_entitlement (Resource)

Grants a server or user a test entitlement to an SKU of the application, so premium features can be tested without a purchase. Discord treats the owner as having the SKU until the entitlement is deleted, which destroying this resource does; reload the Discord client to see the change. A test entitlement never ends. Every argument forces a new entitlement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_skus" "app" {}

# Gives a development server the premium subscription, to test premium features
# without a purchase.
resource "discord_test_entitlement" "dev_server" {
  sku_id     = one([for s in data.discord_skus.app.skus : s.id if s.type == "subscription"])
  owner_type = "server"
  owner_id   = var.server_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner_id` (String) ID of the server or user.
- `owner_type` (String) Whether the entitlement is granted to a server or a user: `server`, `user`.
- `sku_id` (String) ID of the SKU, such as one from `data.discord_skus`. For a subscription, use the SKU of type `subscription`.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application. Defaults to the application the provider's bot token belongs to, the only one it can manage.

### Read-Only

- `consumed` (Boolean) For a consumable SKU, whether the entitlement has been consumed.
- `id` (String) Entitlement ID.
- `type` (String) Entitlement type: `purchase`, `premium_subscription`, `developer_gift`, `test_mode_purchase`, `free_purchase`, `user_gift`, `premium_purchase`, `application_subscription`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_test_entitlement.dev_server
  identity = {
    application_id = "456789012345678901"
    entitlement_id = "567890123456789012"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `application_id` (String) ID of the application.
- `entitlement_id` (String) ID of the entitlement.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_test_entitlement.dev_server <application_id>/<entitlement_id>
```
